company.name: ReadySet Technology
company.shortDescription: ReadySet is a distributed SQL cache that helps developers build scalable, real-time applications without code or database changes.
company.description: ReadySet is a distributed SQL caching layer that precomputes the results of parameterized SQL queries and incrementally updates these results as the underlying data changes. It is wire-compatible with MySQL and Postgres, plugs directly into existing databases and applications without any code changes, and elastically scales read throughput to meet fluctuating demands. ReadySet offers the low latencies of a custom caching system and the high query throughputs of read replicas with the straightforward developer experience of using a single relational database.

productsAndServices.description: A distributed SQL caching engine for PostgreSQL and MySQL that accelerates query performance by caching query results and updating them incrementally without code changes.
